title: Billing Method Statement: Proration of the Final Package Fee Over a 30-Day Month
content:
# Proration of the Final Package Fee — Utility Services Program, All-Inclusive Utility Package

**Method.** Final package fees of the All-Inclusive Utility Package are prorated over a 30-day month: the days of responsibility of the final period are the days from the period-end water read of the last period that carries a package fee line to the service end date, and the final package fee line records the days charged as its proration days over 30 days in the period. The final package fee line bills the package's monthly fee times the days of responsibility divided by 30, rounded half up to the cent; the days charged are the days of responsibility.

**Other periods.** Package fees and flat amounts of every period other than the final period of an account in final billing, and the package gas allowance of every period including the final one, remain prorated for a partial month by days of responsibility over the actual days of the period, rounded half up to the cent (the gas allowance to 3 decimals).

## Inputs and records

| Input | Record |
|---|---|
| last period that carries a package fee line | the billing period of the account's latest package fee line |
| its period-end water read | the water read of that billing period, by its read date |
| service end date | the account's service end date |
| monthly fee | the All-Inclusive Utility Package's monthly package fee |

## Worked example (hypothetical dates; hypothetical monthly fee of $150.00, not the package's tariff)

The account's latest package fee line bills May; May's period-end water read is dated May 31; the service end date is June 18.

- Days of responsibility: May 31 to June 18 is 18 days.
- Line: $150.00 times 18 divided by 30 is $90.00, recorded with 18 proration days over 30 days in period.

*Rounding case (hypothetical):* with 7 days of responsibility and the same monthly fee, $150.00 times 7 divided by 30 is $35.00; with a monthly fee of $149.99 it is $34.9977, which is $35.00 rounded half up to the cent.
